sentences.zh: 山西之太原府石、忻、代、平定、保德、岢嵐六州，平陽府，皆參分。

translations.literal: The six departments of Shi, Xin, Dai, Pingding, Baode, and Kelan of Taiyuan prefecture in Shanxi, and Pingyang prefecture—all Triaster allotment.
translations.idiomatic: Shanxi Taiyuan’s Shi, Xin, Dai, Pingding, Baode, and Kelan departments and Pingyang prefecture—all Triaster.

sentences.zh: 絳、蒲、吉、隰、解、霍六州皆觜、參分。

translations.literal: The six departments of Jiang, Pu, Ji, Xi, Jie, and Huo—all Turtle Beak and Triaster allotment.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang, Pu, Ji, Xi, Jie, and Huo departments—all Turtle Beak and Triaster.

sentences.zh: 澤、汾二州，皆參分。

translations.literal: Ze and Fen departments—all Triaster allotment.
translations.idiomatic: Ze and Fen departments—all Triaster.

sentences.zh: 潞、沁、遼三州，皆參、井分。

translations.literal: Lu, Qin, and Liao departments—all Triaster and Well allotment.
translations.idiomatic: Lu, Qin, and Liao departments—all Triaster and Well.

sentences.zh: 井九度至柳三度，鶉首之次也。

translations.literal: From nine degrees of Well to three degrees of Willow—the station of Chunshou.
translations.idiomatic: From nine degrees Well to three degrees Willow—the Chunshou station.

sentences.zh: 陝西布政司所屬之西安府同、華、乾、耀、邠五州，鳳翔府隴州，延安府鄜、綏德、葭三州，漢中府金州，臨洮、平涼二府，靜寧州，皆井、鬼分。

translations.literal: The five departments of Tong, Hua, Qian, Yao, and Bin of Xi’an prefecture under the Shaanxi provincial commission; Longzhou of Fengxiang prefecture; Fu, Suide, and Jia departments of Yan’an prefecture; Jin department of Hanzhong prefecture; Lintao and Pingliang prefectures; Jingning department—all Well and Ghost allotment.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi Xi’an’s Tong, Hua, Qian, Yao, and Bin departments; Fengxiang’s Longzhou; Yan’an’s Fu, Suide, and Jia; Hanzhong’s Jin department; Lintao and Pingliang prefectures; Jingning department—all Well and Ghost.

sentences.zh: 涇州，鬼分。

translations.literal: Jing department—Ghost allotment.
translations.idiomatic: Jing department—Ghost.

sentences.zh: 慶陽府寧州，鞏昌府階、徽、秦三州，皆井、鬼分。

translations.literal: Ning department of Qingyang prefecture; the three departments of Jie, Hui, and Qin of Gongchang prefecture—all Well and Ghost allotment.
translations.idiomatic: Qingyang’s Ning department; Gongchang’s Jie, Hui, and Qin departments—all Well and Ghost.

sentences.zh: 四川布政司所屬惟綿州觜分，合州參、井分，余皆井、鬼分。

translations.literal: Under the Sichuan provincial commission only Mian department is Turtle Beak allotment, He department Triaster and Well allotment; the rest are all Well and Ghost allotment.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan: only Mian is Turtle Beak; He is Triaster and Well; all else is Well and Ghost.

sentences.zh: 雲南布政司所屬皆井、鬼分。

translations.literal: All jurisdictions of the Yunnan provincial commission are Well and Ghost allotment.
translations.idiomatic: All of Yunnan—Well and Ghost.

sentences.zh: 柳四度至張十五度，鶉火之次也。

translations.literal: From four degrees of Willow to fifteen degrees of Extended Net—the station of Chunhuo.
translations.idiomatic: From four degrees Willow to fifteen degrees Extended Net—the Chunhuo station.

sentences.zh: 河南之河南府陝州，皆柳分。

translations.literal: Shan department of Henan prefecture in Henan—all Willow allotment.
translations.idiomatic: Henan prefecture’s Shan department—all Willow.

sentences.zh: 南陽府鄧、汝、裕三州，汝寧府之信陽、羅山二縣，開封府之均、許二州，陝西西安府之商縣，華州之洛南縣，湖廣佈政司所屬德安府之隨州，襄陽府之均州、光化縣，皆張分。

translations.literal: The three departments of Deng, Ru, and Yu of Nanyang prefecture; the two counties of Xinyang and Luoshan of Runing prefecture; the two departments of Jun and Xu of Kaifeng prefecture; Shang county of Xi’an prefecture in Shaanxi; Luonan county of Hua department; Suizhou of De’an prefecture under the Huguang provincial commission; Jun department and Guanghua county of Xiangyang prefecture—all Extended Net allotment.
translations.idiomatic: Nanyang’s Deng, Ru, and Yu departments; Runing’s Xinyang and Luoshan counties; Kaifeng’s Jun and Xu departments; Shaanxi Xi’an’s Shang county and Hua’s Luonan; Huguang De’an’s Suizhou; Xiangyang’s Jun department and Guanghua county—all Extended Net.

sentences.zh: 張十六度至軫九度，鶉尾之次也。

translations.literal: From sixteen degrees of Extended Net to nine degrees of Chariot—station of Chunwei.
translations.idiomatic: From sixteen degrees Extended Net to nine degrees Chariot—the Chunwei station.

sentences.zh: 湖廣之武昌府興國州，荊州府歸、夷陵、荊門三州，黃州府蘄州，襄陽、德安二府，安陸、沔陽二州，皆翼、軫分。

translations.literal: Xingguo department of Wuchang prefecture in Huguang; the three departments of Gui, Yiling, and Jingmen of Jingzhou prefecture; Qizhou of Huangzhou prefecture; Xiangyang and De’an prefectures; Anlu and Mianyang departments—all Wings and Chariot allotment.
translations.idiomatic: Huguang Wuchang’s Xingguo department; Jingzhou’s Gui, Yiling, and Jingmen; Huangzhou’s Qizhou; Xiangyang and De’an prefectures; Anlu and Mianyang departments—all Wings and Chariot.

sentences.zh: 長沙府軫旁小星曰長沙，應其地。

translations.literal: Beside Chariot in Changsha prefecture is a small star called Changsha, corresponding to that land.
translations.idiomatic: A small star beside Chariot in Changsha prefecture is named Changsha and answers to that territory.

sentences.zh: 衡州府桂陽州，永州府全、道二州，岳州、常德二府，澧州，辰州府沅州，漢陽府靖、郴二州，寶慶府武岡、鎮遠二州，皆翼、軫分。

translations.literal: Guiyang department of Hengzhou prefecture; the two departments of Quan and Dao of Yongzhou prefecture; Yuezhou and Changde prefectures; Li department; Yuan department of Chenzhou prefecture; the two departments of Jing and Chen of Hanyang prefecture; Wugang and Zhenyuan departments of Baoqing prefecture—all Wings and Chariot allotment.
translations.idiomatic: Hengzhou’s Guiyang department; Yongzhou’s Quan and Dao; Yuezhou and Changde; Li department; Chenzhou’s Yuan; Hanyang’s Jing and Chen; Baoqing’s Wugang and Zhenyuan—all Wings and Chariot.

sentences.zh: 廣西所屬除梧州府之蒼梧、籐、容、岑溪四縣屬牛、女分，余皆翼、軫分。

translations.literal: Within Guangxi, except the four counties of Cangwu, Teng, Rong, and Cenxi in Wuzhou prefecture, which belong to Ox and Maid allotment, the rest are all Wings and Chariot allotment.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi: except Wuzhou’s Cangwu, Teng, Rong, and Cenxi counties under Ox and Maid, all else is Wings and Chariot.

sentences.zh: 廣東之連州、廉州府欽州、韶州府，皆翼、軫分。

translations.literal: Lian department; Qin department of Lianzhou prefecture; and Shaozhou prefecture of Guangdong—all Wings and Chariot allotment.
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong’s Lian department; Lianzhou’s Qin department; and Shaozhou—all Wings and Chariot.

sentences.zh: 軫十度至氐一度，壽星之次也。

translations.literal: From ten degrees of Chariot to one degree of Root—the station of Shouxing.
translations.idiomatic: From ten degrees Chariot to one degree Root—the Shouxing station.

sentences.zh: 河南之開封府，角、亢分。

translations.literal: Kaifeng prefecture of Henan—Horn and Neck allotment.
translations.idiomatic: Henan’s Kaifeng prefecture—Horn and Neck.

sentences.zh: 鄭州，氐分。

translations.literal: Zheng department—Root allotment.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng department—Root.

sentences.zh: 陳州，亢分。

translations.literal: Chen prefecture—Neck allotment.
translations.idiomatic: Chen prefecture—Neck.

sentences.zh: 汝寧府光州，懷慶府之孟、濟源、溫三縣，直隸壽州之霍丘縣，皆角、亢、氐分。

translations.literal: Guang department of Runing prefecture; the three counties of Meng, Jiyuan, and Wen of Huaqing prefecture; Huoqiu county of Shou department in Zhili—all Horn, Neck, and Root allotment.
translations.idiomatic: Runing’s Guang department; Huaqing’s Meng, Jiyuan, and Wen counties; Zhili Shou department’s Huoqiu—all Horn, Neck, and Root.

sentences.zh: 氐二度至尾二度，大火之次也。

translations.literal: From two degrees of Root to two degrees of Tail—the station of Dahu.
translations.idiomatic: From two degrees Root to two degrees Tail—the Dahu station.

sentences.zh: 河南開封府之杞、太康、儀封、蘭陽四縣，歸德、睢二州，山東之濟寧府，皆房、心分。

translations.literal: The four counties of Qi, Taikang, Yifeng, and Lanyang of Kaifeng prefecture in Henan; Guide and Sui departments; Jining prefecture of Shandong—all Room and Heart allotment.
translations.idiomatic: Henan Kaifeng’s Qi, Taikang, Yifeng, and Lanyang counties; Guide and Sui departments; Shandong’s Jining prefecture—all Room and Heart.

sentences.zh: 直隸鳳陽府之穎州，房分。

translations.literal: Ying department of Fengyang prefecture in Zhili—Room allotment.
translations.idiomatic: Zhili Fengyang’s Ying department—Room.

sentences.zh: 徐、宿二州，壽州之蒙城縣，穎州之亳縣，皆房、心分。

translations.literal: Xu and Su departments; Mengcheng county of Shou department; Bo county of Ying department—all Room and Heart allotment.
translations.idiomatic: Xu and Su departments; Shou’s Mengcheng; Ying’s Bo county—all Room and Heart.

sentences.zh: 尾三度至斗二度，析木之次也。

translations.literal: From three degrees of Tail to two degrees of Dipper—the station of Ximu.
translations.idiomatic: From three degrees Tail to two degrees Dipper—the Ximu station.

sentences.zh: 北平之北平府，尾、箕分。

translations.literal: Beiping prefecture of Beiping—Tail and Winnowing Basket allotment.
translations.idiomatic: Beiping’s Beiping prefecture—Tail and Winnowing Basket.

sentences.zh: 涿、通、薊三州，皆尾分。

translations.literal: Zhuo, Tong, and Ji departments—all Tail allotment.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuo, Tong, and Ji departments—all Tail.

sentences.zh: 霸州、保定府，皆尾、箕分。

translations.literal: Bazhou and Baoding prefecture—all Tail and Winnowing Basket allotment.
translations.idiomatic: Bazhou and Baoding prefecture—all Tail and Winnowing Basket.

sentences.zh: 易、安二州，皆尾分。

translations.literal: Yi and An departments—all Tail allotment.
translations.idiomatic: Yi and An departments—all Tail.

sentences.zh: 河間府、景州，皆尾、箕分。

translations.literal: Hejian prefecture and Jing department—all Tail and Winnowing Basket allotment.
translations.idiomatic: Hejian prefecture and Jing department—all Tail and Winnowing Basket.

sentences.zh: 永平府，尾分。

translations.literal: Yongping prefecture—Tail allotment.
translations.idiomatic: Yongping prefecture—Tail.

sentences.zh: 灤州，尾、箕分。

translations.literal: Luan department—Tail and Winnowing Basket allotment.
translations.idiomatic: Luan department—Tail and Winnowing Basket.

sentences.zh: 遼東都指揮司，尾、箕分。

translations.literal: The Liaodong regional command—Tail and Winnowing Basket allotment.
translations.idiomatic: Liaodong regional command—Tail and Winnowing Basket.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮，箕分。

translations.literal: Korea—Winnowing Basket allotment.
translations.idiomatic: Korea—Winnowing Basket.
